en.declarativeNetRequestSandbox_description: Which rules of Declarative Net Request (modifying HTTP headers and GET parameters, blocking requests, redirecting HTTP to HTTPS) target the page of the active tab and what they do, with temporary suspension of a rule (everywhere or only for the domain of the page), and in Settings the editor of the rules with the overview of the suspended rules. It runs in a sandbox: Declarative Net Request converts the rules into the browser and keeps them for it.
en.declarativeNetRequestSandbox_depends_dec: It converts the rules into the browser, keeps them and their suspensions and reads them for the overview and the editor — without it nothing is shown and no rule applies.
en.declarativeNetRequestSandbox_missing_per: Missing permission to modify and block requests (declarativeNetRequestWithHostAccess and access to all pages).
en.declarativeNetRequestSandbox_not_web_pag: This is not a web page, modification rules don't apply here.
en.declarativeNetRequestSandbox_no_backgrou: The rules status cannot be determined. $2
en.declarativeNetRequestSandbox_rules_apply: Rules that apply to this page:
en.declarativeNetRequestSandbox_no_rules: No rule applies to this page.
en.declarativeNetRequestSandbox_suspend_tit: The rule stops applying for 1 hour (everywhere it targets), then the permanent rule applies again. Applies to new requests — an already loaded page changes after a reload; the overview is in the module's Settings.
en.declarativeNetRequestSandbox_restore_tit: Ends the temporary suspension — the permanent rule applies again (to new requests).
en.declarativeNetRequestSandbox_suspend_dom: The rule stops applying for 1 hour only for the domain $1 (with its subdomains): to requests to it and to files its pages load from elsewhere; elsewhere it applies on. Then the permanent rule applies again. Applies to new requests — an already loaded page changes after a reload; the overview is in the module's Settings.
en.declarativeNetRequestSandbox_except_doma: Adds $1 permanently to the Except domains of the rule: the rule then applies neither to requests to $1 and its subdomains nor to files its pages load from elsewhere — elsewhere it applies on. Applies to new requests — an already loaded page changes after a reload; the domain can be removed in the rules editor.
en.declarativeNetRequestSandbox_restore_dom: Ends the temporary suspension for $1 — the permanent rule applies there again (to new requests).
en.declarativeNetRequestSandbox_via_domain: via the domain: the page and the files it loads
en.declarativeNetRequestSandbox_via_page: via the address: only requests to this address
en.declarativeNetRequestSandbox_reload_hint: Modifications apply to requests made after the rules were saved — a page loaded earlier gets them only after a reload.
en.declarativeNetRequestSandbox_block_domai: Adds the domain $1 to the rule “Direct blocking list created by browsing” of Declarative Net Request: the browser then blocks all requests to it and its subdomains — its pages and the files other pages load from there. The rule can be changed or removed in the editor (Edit rules).
en.declarativeNetRequestSandbox_block_url_t: Adds the exact address of this page ($1) to the rule “Direct blocking list created by browsing” of Declarative Net Request: the browser then blocks requests to exactly this address; the other pages of the domain stay. The rule can be changed or removed in the editor (Edit rules).
en.declarativeNetRequestSandbox_block_done: Blocked — $1 is in the rule “$2”. A page loaded earlier stays as it is until it is reloaded.
en.declarativeNetRequestSandbox_except_done: $1 is in the Except domains of the rule “$2” now — after a reload of the page the rule does not apply here.
en.declarativeNetRequestSandbox_except_alre: $1 is already in the Except domains of the rule “$2”.
en.declarativeNetRequestSandbox_block_permi: $1 is in the rule “$2”, but Declarative Net Request lacks its permission — without it nothing is blocked.
en.declarativeNetRequestSandbox_block_inact: $1 is in the rule “$2”, but the rule does not apply in the browser (it is turned off, temporarily suspended or does not block pages) — check it in the editor (Edit rules).
en.declarativeNetRequestSandbox_block_rejec: $1 is in the rule “$2”, but the browser did not accept the rules — the details are in the editor (Edit rules).
en.declarativeNetRequestSandbox_block_modul: $1 is in the rule “$2”, but Declarative Net Request is turned off or not in the module list — without it nothing is blocked.
en.declarativeNetRequestSandbox_param_remov: remove parameters $1 and $2 (only when both are in the address)
en.declarativeNetRequestSandbox_param_set_p: set parameters $1=$3 and $2=$3 (only when both are in the address)

en.declarativeNetRequestSandbox_suspensions: Rules suspended with the “Suspend rule temporarily” button (everywhere) or “Suspend rule temporarily for …” (only for the domain of the page) in the overview of the rules for the page. en.declarativeNetRequestSandbox_notify_gran: Matched rules will be announced silently.

en.declarativeNetRequestSandbox_notify_requ: Blocked requests this rule targets will be announced silently. The browser does not say which rule blocked a request — a request blocked by another module or extension is announced too.
en.declarativeNetRequestSandbox_notify_upgr: Requests this rule targets that the browser redirects to HTTPS will be announced silently. The browser does not say what redirected a request — a redirect by another module or extension, or by the browser itself (e.g. HSTS), is announced too.
en.declarativeNetRequestSandbox_notify_requ: Notifications and tracking of blocked and redirected requests require browser permission — allow it with the button at the top, above the rules.
en.declarativeNetRequestSandbox_log_feedbac: This browser does not expose matched-rule events (Chrome exposes them only to unpacked extensions) — without them only rules that block requests or redirect them to HTTPS can write into the event log.
en.declarativeNetRequestSandbox_log_granted: Matched rules will be written into the event log — it is listed at the bottom of the overview of the rules for the page.
en.declarativeNetRequestSandbox_log_request: Blocked requests this rule targets will be written into the event log (at the bottom of the overview of the rules for the page). The browser does not say which rule blocked a request — a request blocked by another module or extension is written too.
en.declarativeNetRequestSandbox_log_upgrade: Requests this rule targets that the browser redirects to HTTPS will be written into the event log (at the bottom of the overview of the rules for the page). The browser does not say what redirected a request — a redirect by another module or extension, or by the browser itself (e.g. HSTS), is written too.
en.declarativeNetRequestSandbox_log_ask: The event log requires browser permission to track matched rules — allow it with the button at the top, above the rules.
en.declarativeNetRequestSandbox_log_request: The event log requires browser permission to track blocked and redirected requests — allow it with the button at the top, above the rules.
en.declarativeNetRequestSandbox_editor_hint: A rule says WHAT to do (modify headers sent to the server or received from it, modify GET parameters in the address, block the requests, or redirect them from HTTP to HTTPS), WHICH requests (page, frames, scripts, …) and WHERE (domains, addresses, bookmark folder; Except domains, where it doesn't apply). Several rules on one request add up; when two rules change the same header, the one higher in the list wins, and blocking takes precedence over modifications. The browser does the modifications and the blocking itself — after saving, for all further requests.
en.declarativeNetRequestSandbox_editor_comm: Notes: anything between /* and */ in the text fields of a rule is a comment — it stays saved, but the rule ignores it. In addresses and values a comment has to start at the beginning of a line or after a space, because /* can be a part of them (https://example.com/*, */*).

en.declarativeNetRequestSandbox_editor_what: request headers (sent by the browser to the server) or response headers (sent by the server); common headers are suggested, any header can be entered
en.declarativeNetRequestSandbox_editor_para: parameters after “?” in the request address — the browser redirects the request to the address with the modified parameters; common tracking parameters are suggested, any parameter can be entered (case matters). Set value overwrites the parameter, or adds it. A rule with Set value targets every request in its scope — parameter rules lower in the list no longer change anything there, and Firefox doesn't apply header modifications there. A related parameter (“and at the same time”): the modification applies only to addresses that contain both parameters; Remove or Set value applies to both.
en.declarativeNetRequestSandbox_editor_bloc: the browser blocks the requests the rule targets: a file isn't loaded, a blocked page or frame ends with the browser's error page. WebSocket connections can be blocked too.

Scripts blocks only the JavaScript files the page downloads (<script src>, import). Inline scripts written right in the page's HTML (<script>…</script>, attributes such as onclick, javascript: links) are not requests of their own, so they keep running on the page.

All the page's scripts, inline ones included, are stopped by the Content-Security-Policy header: add another rule, in What to do choose Modify headers with the row Response · Content-Security-Policy · Append value · script-src 'none', in Which requests check Page (and Frames to stop them there too) and in Where enter the domains of the pages. After the page is reloaded it runs no script. Append value (not Set value) keeps the page's own CSP in force as well.
en.declarativeNetRequestSandbox_editor_upgr: the browser loads the http:// requests the rule targets over HTTPS instead — the same address with https:// in place of http://: pages, frames and files. Only unencrypted requests are redirected (so the rule has no request protocol), WebSocket connections aren't (Chrome doesn't redirect them to wss://). A server without HTTPS then doesn't load — add it to Except domains. Rules lower in the list then apply to the https:// request.

cs.declarativeNetRequestSandbox_description: Která pravidla Declarative Net Request (úpravy HTTP hlaviček a GET parametrů, blokování požadavků, přesměrování HTTP na HTTPS) míří na stránku aktivní karty a co dělají, s dočasným zrušením pravidla (všude, nebo jen pro doménu stránky), a v Nastavení editor pravidel s přehledem dočasně zrušených pravidel. Běží v sandboxu: pravidla mu do prohlížeče převádí a uchovává Declarative Net Request.
cs.declarativeNetRequestSandbox_depends_dec: Převádí pravidla do prohlížeče, uchovává je i jejich dočasná zrušení a čte je pro přehled a editor — bez něj se nic neukáže a žádné pravidlo neplatí.
cs.declarativeNetRequestSandbox_missing_per: Chybí oprávnění upravovat a blokovat požadavky (declarativeNetRequestWithHostAccess a přístup ke všem stránkám).
cs.declarativeNetRequestSandbox_not_web_pag: Tohle není webová stránka, pravidla úprav tu neplatí.
cs.declarativeNetRequestSandbox_no_rules: Na tuhle stránku nemíří žádné pravidlo.
cs.declarativeNetRequestSandbox_suspend_tit: Pravidlo na 1 hodinu přestane platit (všude, kam míří), pak zase platí trvalé pravidlo. Platí pro nové požadavky — už načtená stránka se změní po obnovení; přehled je v Nastavení modulu.
cs.declarativeNetRequestSandbox_restore_tit: Zruší dočasné zrušení — trvalé pravidlo zase platí (pro nové požadavky).
cs.declarativeNetRequestSandbox_suspend_dom: Pravidlo na 1 hodinu přestane platit jen pro doménu $1 (i její subdomény): pro požadavky na ni a soubory, které její stránky načítají odjinud; jinde platí dál. Pak zase platí trvalé pravidlo. Platí pro nové požadavky — už načtená stránka se změní po obnovení; přehled je v Nastavení modulu.
cs.declarativeNetRequestSandbox_except_doma: Trvale přidá $1 do Kromě domén pravidla: pravidlo pak neplatí pro požadavky na $1 a její subdomény ani pro soubory, které její stránky načítají odjinud — jinde platí dál. Platí pro nové požadavky — už načtená stránka se změní po obnovení; odebrat doménu jde v editoru pravidel.
cs.declarativeNetRequestSandbox_restore_dom: Zruší dočasné zrušení pro $1 — trvalé pravidlo tam zase platí (pro nové požadavky).
cs.declarativeNetRequestSandbox_via_domain: přes doménu: stránka i soubory, které načítá
cs.declarativeNetRequestSandbox_via_page: přes adresu: jen požadavky na tuhle adresu
cs.declarativeNetRequestSandbox_reload_hint: Úpravy platí pro požadavky od uložení pravidel — stránka načtená dřív je dostane až po obnovení.
cs.declarativeNetRequestSandbox_block_domai: Přidá doménu $1 do pravidla „Direct blocking list created by browsing“ modulu Declarative Net Request: prohlížeč pak blokuje všechny požadavky na ni a její subdomény — její stránky i soubory, které z ní načítají jiné stránky. Pravidlo se dá změnit nebo smazat v editoru (Upravit pravidla).
cs.declarativeNetRequestSandbox_block_url_t: Přidá přesnou adresu této stránky ($1) do pravidla „Direct blocking list created by browsing“ modulu Declarative Net Request: prohlížeč pak blokuje požadavky přesně na tuto adresu; ostatní stránky domény zůstanou. Pravidlo se dá změnit nebo smazat v editoru (Upravit pravidla).
cs.declarativeNetRequestSandbox_block_done: Blokováno — $1 je v pravidle „$2“. Stránka načtená dřív zůstane, jak je, do svého nového načtení.
cs.declarativeNetRequestSandbox_except_done: $1 je teď v Kromě domén pravidla „$2“ — po novém načtení stránky tu pravidlo neplatí.
cs.declarativeNetRequestSandbox_except_alre: $1 už v Kromě domén pravidla „$2“ je.
cs.declarativeNetRequestSandbox_block_permi: $1 je v pravidle „$2“, ale modulu Declarative Net Request chybí oprávnění — bez něj se nic neblokuje.
cs.declarativeNetRequestSandbox_block_inact: $1 je v pravidle „$2“, ale pravidlo v prohlížeči neplatí (je vypnuté, dočasně zrušené nebo neblokuje stránky) — zkontroluj ho v editoru (Upravit pravidla).
cs.declarativeNetRequestSandbox_block_rejec: $1 je v pravidle „$2“, ale prohlížeč pravidla nepřijal — podrobnosti jsou v editoru (Upravit pravidla).
cs.declarativeNetRequestSandbox_block_modul: $1 je v pravidle „$2“, ale modul Declarative Net Request je vypnutý nebo není v seznamu modulů — bez něj se nic neblokuje.

cs.declarativeNetRequestSandbox_status_unav: Prohlížeč zatím pravidla declarativeNetRequest nemá k dispozici — zkus rozšíření znovu načíst.
cs.declarativeNetRequestSandbox_status_no_b: Stav pravidel v prohlížeči nejde zjistit. $1

de.declarativeNetRequestSandbox_description: Welche Regeln von Declarative Net Request (Ändern von HTTP-Headern und GET-Parametern, Blockieren von Anfragen, Umleiten von HTTP auf HTTPS) auf die Seite des aktiven Tabs zielen und was sie tun, mit vorübergehendem Aussetzen einer Regel (überall oder nur für die Domain der Seite), und in den Einstellungen der Editor der Regeln mit der Übersicht der ausgesetzten Regeln. Läuft in einer Sandbox: Declarative Net Request überträgt die Regeln in den Browser und bewahrt sie für sie auf.
de.declarativeNetRequestSandbox_depends_dec: Überträgt die Regeln in den Browser, bewahrt sie und ihre Aussetzungen auf und liest sie für die Übersicht und den Editor — ohne es wird nichts angezeigt und keine Regel gilt.
de.declarativeNetRequestSandbox_missing_per: Berechtigung zum Ändern und Blockieren von Anfragen fehlt (declarativeNetRequestWithHostAccess und Zugriff auf alle Seiten).
de.declarativeNetRequestSandbox_not_web_pag: Dies ist keine Webseite, Änderungsregeln gelten hier nicht.
de.declarativeNetRequestSandbox_no_backgrou: Der Status der Regeln lässt sich nicht ermitteln. $2
de.declarativeNetRequestSandbox_no_rules: Für diese Seite gilt keine Regel.
de.declarativeNetRequestSandbox_suspend_tit: Die Regel gilt 1 Stunde lang nicht (überall, wo sie greift), danach gilt wieder die dauerhafte Regel. Gilt für neue Anfragen — eine bereits geladene Seite ändert sich nach dem Neuladen; die Übersicht ist in den Einstellungen des Moduls.
de.declarativeNetRequestSandbox_restore_tit: Beendet die vorübergehende Aussetzung — die dauerhafte Regel gilt wieder (für neue Anfragen).

el.declarativeNetRequestSandbox_description: Ποιοι κανόνες του Declarative Net Request (τροποποίηση κεφαλίδων HTTP και παραμέτρων GET, αποκλεισμός αιτημάτων, ανακατεύθυνση HTTP σε HTTPS) στοχεύουν στη σελίδα της ενεργής καρτέλας και τι κάνουν, με προσωρινή αναστολή κανόνα (παντού ή μόνο για τον τομέα της σελίδας), και στις Ρυθμίσεις ο επεξεργαστής των κανόνων με την επισκόπηση των κανόνων σε αναστολή. Εκτελείται σε sandbox: το Declarative Net Request μεταφέρει τους κανόνες στο πρόγραμμα περιήγησης και τους φυλάσσει για λογαριασμό της.

Len pre úpravy hlavičiek, blokovanie a presmerovanie na HTTPS — pravidlo GET parametrov by potrebovalo regulárny výraz pre každý parameter a každú časť adries.
